recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31849 unless BRR later revisits the broader ClinicalUseDefinition model or the historical ClinicalUseIssue naming, which would be a separate decision.
issue_request: FHIR-31849 was a Published/Persuasive BRR clarification for the R4 ClinicalUseIssue/ClinicalUseDefinition artifact asking what indication.undesireableEffect meant and why it was relevant to an indication. The later Jira comment supplied the target wording: "An unwanted side effect or negative outcome that may happen if you use the drug (or other subject of this resource) for this indication".
initial_application: No source-history commit explicitly mentions FHIR-31849. Commit d99459f74a7b955aff3fd87bae9662f127aa2c49, made on 2022-02-01 shortly after the Jira wording comment, changed ClinicalUseDefinition.indication.undesirableEffect from vague "specific undesirable effects" wording to the requested unwanted side-effect/negative-outcome wording. The commit subject appears to cite adjacent FHIR#31850 while changing undesirableEffect, so the historical Jira key looks likely mislabelled. BRR minutes from 2022-02-10 separately record FHIR-31849 as "Change has been applied".
additional_context: The old ClinicalUseIssue artifact is now represented in the current build as ClinicalUseDefinition. source/fhir.ini actively includes ClinicalUseDefinition as a resource, marks it normative, assigns the cud code, and marks it approved. A later FHIR-48631 refactor in commit cd2490a5c55b816536b503b0cf85ffeed54c8e30 reorganized ClinicalUseDefinition backbone references and preserved the clarified short and definition. Zulip searches for FHIR-31849 and the element wording found no direct conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The authoritative current source/clinicalusedefinition/structuredefinition-ClinicalUseDefinition.xml entry for ClinicalUseDefinition.indication.undesirableEffect already states that the element is an unwanted side effect or negative outcome of the subject when used for this indication, and its definition exactly matches the Jira-provided wording with only a terminal period.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent ClinicalUseIssue/ClinicalUseDefinition ballot issue about indication.duration; the historical commit subject appears to cite this key while applying the FHIR-31849 undesirableEffect wording.
Later ClinicalUseDefinition refactor that preserved the FHIR-31849 clarification while changing backbone references.
